additional_info.subject: RE: ID0414769-DC/Si-D/DE-[170000790] System not available CRM:02678000022
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I hope you are doing well.
Regarding the reported issue, we have analyzed the charger error flags and identified the error
SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income
.
Based on this, please refer to the following steps to be performed for a better understanding of the issue
Check for the connector and fuses of SPD.
For connector, Check for FA1 Plug - FA1:11 and FA1:12. Check if it is receiving 24V.
Then for Fuses, Check whether FC1.1, FC1.2 and FC1.3 are connected properly or not/ or might be blown up.
As shown in the picture above, if the inspection window is RED, then we need to replace SPD.
Additionally, kindly refer to the knowledge article below for further reference:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_SPD_ Surge Protection Income error - Dynamics 365
If a replacement is needed, please carry the following spare parts:
SPD-: 8EM5903-0AA00-2AA0
Signal Detector HRC Fuse
3NX1021 , 3NX1022
Note-:
For ERK related charger’s the repair must be done by the certified technician and proper seal and calibration is required.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav

additional_info.subject: error fixed
additional_info.body: After troubleshooting as described, it was determined that the 24V supply to FC1.2 was interrupted; the fuses were apparently OK, and no problems could be detected with the SPD either; by pressing on FC1.2 (it appeared to have slipped slightly), the problem was resolved, and the charger was ready for use again.
